author: Jeronetj3
body:
In this game there’s a lot of lore but not really any religion (or faith like you’d have in D&D for example).

Something in Orna or HoA that comes closest to it are the factions (4 basic elements in the game) it boosts your attack for that element and gives you resistance and there’s some playable classes that can only be unlocked while in such an faction.

author: nicolasallasia
body:
Dragons are the creators of the land and the sky. What are called "gods" are just powerful entities that have now lost most of their powers after the cataclysm and the work of Morrigan and Apollyon.
